lead: A `!= null` guard does not re-type a nullable local for an *argument* position; `as string` inside the guarded branch does.
body: `rule:expressions/nullable-conversion`'s narrowing only lets `->` reach a member of a `?Foo`, so `Core\Str::replace($r, …)` inside `if ($r != null)` is `E0401: expected string, found string|null`, and declaring the local `?string` changes nothing. Write `$r as string` in the branch (a checked `rule:types/conversion`), or `$r ?? "<null>"` where the value is only echoed.
